t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Make sure you keep fingers on the keys and press them in time so you at least get some points. Use the breaks as it will become tiring. I found the pink and orange gave me the most points but it might have been luck

vb_textbox.text: Make sure you dont forget to press the space bar to collect the mushrooms. Take the breaks as it becomes quite tiring on the eyes. Ii found the light pink and orange gave the most points.
